serviceDescription: SecureKnots LLC is a governance, risk and compliance consultancy headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware, with delivery hubs in London (SecureKnots Limited) and Bengaluru (SecureKnots Pvt Ltd). We help cloud service providers prepare for FedRAMP Certification under FedRAMP 20x, Classes A to D, and FedRAMP Rev5. One SecureKnots team owns the program from start to finish: scope, readiness and gap assessment, Key Security Indicator validation design, process design, the FedRAMP Certification Package in human-readable and machine-readable (JSON) formats, coordination with the provider's FedRAMP Recognized independent assessor, and ongoing certification support. Our practitioners work from one unified control set across 40 frameworks and regulations, including GovRAMP, CMMC, CUI (NIST SP 800-171), DFARS, ITAR, EAR, NIST SP 800-53, SOC 1, SOC 2 and SOC 3, ISO/IEC 27001, 27701 and 42001, ISO management system standards and privacy laws, so evidence is gathered once and reused across every audit. Independence is preserved: SecureKnots does not perform FedRAMP independent assessments. The independent assessment stays with the provider's FedRAMP Recognized assessor, and certification decisions stay with FedRAMP. General inquiries: contact@secureknots.com.
